Class Task

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.entities.Task
@Entity public class Task extends Object
Something the user has to do: a title, a description, how far it has got, and when it was added and last changed. Kept until the user deletes it.

The rules a task is saved under (a title that is not blank, both texts trimmed and within their limits) are TaskService's, which refuses a task that breaks one with a message the screen shows. The constraints here only stop a task that slipped past the service from reaching the database.

Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan
